newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Benefun sees double digit profit growth in 97/98.
newsitem.headline: Benefun sees double digit profit growth in 97/98.

text.p: Benefun International Holdings Ltd, which is seeking a dual listing in the Hong Kong and Singapore, expects a double digit profit growth in fiscal 1997/98, Lawrence Lo, a Benefun director said on Monday.

The casual wear retailer and manufacturer posted a net profit of HK$38.83 million for the year ended in June 1996. "Of which more than 60 percent came from China and the remaining was from Hong Kong and Taiwan," Lo told an initial public offering news conference.
"The profit ratio from China will continue to rise and we expect it to grow to over 65 percent in 1997/98," he said.
Benefun forecast a net profit of not less than HK$54.5 million in fiscal 1996/97, up 40.36 percent a year earlier.
Its subsidiary, the Fun Group, manufactures and sells casual wear with its own brands, FUN and Kaimara, through 263 outlets in China, said Chen Miao Zhu, executive director of Benefun.
"We plan to increase the number of outlets in China to 360 by end of 1998," she said.
The company also retails a wide range of men's, ladies' and children's wear under the United Colors of Benetton, Sisley, 012 and Zerotondo brandnames in Hong Kong and Taiwan.
It has 20 outlets in Hong Kong and 56 in Taiwan.
Benefun was issuing 100 million new shares, or 25 percent of the company's enlarged share capital, in an initial public offering in Hong Kong to raise a total of HK$115 million.

At the same time, Benefun's existing shareholder Heshe Holdings Ltd would sell its entire stake, or 59.13 percent of the ompany's enlarged share capital, in a preferential sale to its shareholders, a listing document said.
Dealing in the shares was expected to start in June 3 in both Hong Kong and Singapore.
"After the listing its chairman Tan Sim Chew and his associates will hold about 27 percent of the company," said Gary Sik, a director of NatWest Markets Corporate Finance Asia Ltd.
NatWest Securities is the sponsor of the new issue.
